title: From drums to E-flat tuba, and the first school band
summary: He began on drums at the school, was picked for bass because of his size, got a tuba his mother bought, and then formed a high school band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Oh, not too very long. Yeah, I started to tell you. I started going- And the gang of the neighborhood started telling me about the school, so I got interested. And it was a good place to go in the evening after school, I mean, to keep you out of mischief. So I started going around. And I started taking, I had a little printing under this teacher there. Oh, I can't think of now. And then I was taking up Coventry. And then I started going and listening to the band. Well, they had enough fellow youngsters there to organize a little band using the Red Book and the EZ Method, and the EZ Method. EZ Method. And from then you go into the Red Book. And I started playing drums with the intention of getting on the saxophone. But in the meantime, the band was progressing so fast, they didn't have anybody to play bass. So Professor Middleton chose me by me being large. I was always large in size. And so he suggested that I play bass because, you know, it was a big instrument. Big fella, big instrument. So I started taking bass lessons and he finally found an E-flat upright tuba at Royal Irons. And he went by and got my mother interested and she bought that for me. I think at that time she paid $55 or $65 or something like that for her. And I started playing the bass tuba. Thank you. And, well, I stayed with the little group until I got into high school. When I got to high school with Albert Wicker, that's when we started our first orchestra, a bunch of fellas from down in the Tremade District, they call it, the seventh, I mean the fifth ward. And we started a little band called Crescent City High Hatters. That was Maurice and Joyce, Justin and Harold Antwine, Andrew, Alexis, James Leysen.
